name: Nufarm Limited
summary: Nufarm Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of crop protection products in Australia, New Zealand, Asia, the United Kingdom, the European Union, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the United States, Canada, and Mexico. It operates through Crop Protection and Seed Technologies segments. The company offers crop protection and seed treatment products used by farmers to protect crops from damage caused by weeds, pests, and disease. It also sells seed or oil-based products through seeds and renewable oils platforms comprising bioenergy and omega-3. In addition, the company is involved in licensing of intellectual property.
